reason: AFG is a risk-bearing specialty P&C insurer. It underwrites commercial specialty policies through its Great American Insurance Group subsidiaries. Brown & Brown is an insurance and risk-management brokerage and advisory firm. It places coverage from carriers for its clients and also sells employee benefits and personal lines. The two sit in neighboring parts of the insurance industry but earn money differently. The target takes on underwriting risk and earns premiums. The comp is an intermediary and does not carry underwriting risk. Customer overlap is only partial, because Brown & Brown also serves individuals and benefits buyers.
reason_if_0: Different business model: AFG underwrites and carries insurance risk, while Brown & Brown brokers and advises on coverage placed with carriers.
